articles.title: TKMS CFO Says Greenland Crisis Could Help Deal For Canada Subs
articles.summary: TKMS CFO Paul Glaser indicated that the escalating geopolitical situation concerning Greenland could significantly boost their chances of securing a multi-billion euro submarine contract. This highlights how international crises, particularly those involving strategically important regions like the Arctic, influence major defence procurement decisions and the demand for advanced naval capabilities, underscoring the interplay between geopolitics and military readiness.

articles.title: Parag Parikh Large Cap Fund opens for subscription. Who should invest?
articles.summary: The Parag Parikh Large Cap Fund, a new fund offer (NFO) by PPFAS Mutual Fund, is currently open for subscription. This investment scheme provides an opportunity for investors to participate in the capital market. The NFO will close on January 30, 2026, after which it will reopen for continuous sale and repurchase, allowing ongoing investment and redemption for long-term financial planning.

articles.title: 'Once called BIMARU, today a progressive, safe state': UP Minister Suresh Khanna at WEF 2026 in Davos
articles.summary: Uttar Pradesh Finance Minister Suresh Kumar Khanna led a high-level delegation to the 56th World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland. The delegation aimed to showcase UP's economic potential and attract global investment. This initiative highlights India's proactive engagement in international economic forums, seeking to boost state development and contribute to national growth by fostering foreign partnerships and investment opportunities.

articles.title: Trump’s Greenland Threat Puts Europe Inc Back in Tariff Crosshairs
articles.summary: President Donald Trump has renewed trade tensions by threatening new tariffs on European companies, disrupting hard-won deals from the previous year. This move places European businesses back in a state of uncertainty, signaling a potential escalation in economic disputes with the United States. Aspirants should note how global trade policies impact international relations and economic stability.

articles.title: India achieves record electronics export in 2025 at $47 billion, PLI drives growth
articles.summary: India achieved record electronics exports valued at USD 47 billion (approximately Rs 4.15 lakh crore) in the recently concluded year 2025. This significant milestone was announced by the Union Minister for Electronics and IT, highlighting the nation's robust growth in the manufacturing sector. This surge underscores India's increasing competitiveness and pivotal role in the global electronics market, signaling strong economic progress and potential for further development.

articles.title: OTT releases this week (Jan 19 - 25): New movies and shows on Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video, ZEE5 and more
articles.summary: January 2026's third week is marked by significant film premieres across Indian screens, continuing a blockbuster trend. A major highlight is the digital debut of Dhanush’s romantic drama 'Tere Ishk Mein' on Netflix. This reflects India’s vibrant entertainment landscape, offering insights into national cultural consumption and media trends.
